note: Short guidance the AI fix writer may use to reword the Change line of a fix. Only the rubric mapped to an issue's rule is sent. Derived from the Avara Launch Scanner skills review-launch-copy and review-hierarchy-and-trust (vendor/avara-launch/skills). Every other rule keeps Avara's deterministic fix text.

rubrics.title: Copy and tone
guidance: Suggest one concrete replacement label or sentence, in plain words, that names what happens next.
Keep the original meaning and the site's own voice; do not add claims, numbers or urgency the page does not support.
Quote the existing wording only from the evidence given; never invent page content.
If the visitor goal is given, name the action in terms of that goal.
Do not promise more sign-ups or conversions; wording changes are a hypothesis.

rubrics.title: Visual hierarchy
guidance: Describe the smallest visual change that makes the intended element read as what it is (an action, a heading, a field).
State the measured observation first; describe any effect on attention as a hypothesis.
Do not change brand colours, fonts or layout beyond the element named.
